scope_limits: Trusted local operator, authoritative wall clock and latest C05 history; no external anti-rollback checkpoint or trusted hardware clock.
Pinned single publisher and separate recovery key; no TUF protocol, threshold signatures, remote download or automated signing-key migration.
Verification records exact file digest and length at check time, not installed/running software. Callers supply bounded local readers and must control their blocking behavior.
Append-only bounded state; at most 8 KiB metadata, 2 KiB recovery grant, 16 offered releases, 64 cumulative revocations, 64 MiB configured artifact bound and 1 MiB public status.
No database schema, migration, .env, Dockerfile, lockfile or required-provider change. C28 measurements, full C30 restart/restore and C40 release remain pending.
